reponse: The production cutover was first planned for Saturday Nov 21, 02:00–06:00 UTC, per the migration plan [1], the customer maintenance notice [3] and ticket KES-509 [4]. It has since moved to Saturday Nov 28, same window: Slack announced the change after a 12/11 ingest incident prompted a second prod-sized dry run [2], and infra PR #233 moves the Terraform cutover date and status page entry to 2026-11-28, plan only, still awaiting review [6]. The sources contradict each other; the Nov 28 date is the more recent [2][6].
